title: Prune unselected relation evidence materialization in the canonical compiler

implementation.summary: Explicit requested RelationSignature records are validated once before Forest evidence materialization. Every supplied Forest edge still has its endpoints checked against the Fourfold partition, but _forest_edge_atoms and fact bundles are produced only for requested forward or reverse signatures. Verified-binding facts outside the explicit requested set are not materialized. When signatures is None, discover-all behavior remains unchanged.
preserved_contracts: Forest/snapshot digest and revision binding remain global.
Every supplied Forest edge endpoint is validated before signature pruning.
FourfoldSnapshot remains the authority that validates every verified binding endpoint and revision.
verified_binding_count remains the source binding count when verified bindings are included.
Explicit requested empty blocks remain supported.
Discover-all behavior remains unchanged when signatures is None.

coverage: An explicit code:declares:type request does not hash/materialize unrelated imports Forest evidence.
An explicit code:imports:code request does not materialize an unselected verified cross-plane binding fact.
Malformed explicit signatures fail before Forest evidence materialization.
The signatures-is-None discover-all path still materializes all observed Forest relation families.
Source receipt counts are preserved under selected-signature pruning.

verification.evidence_scope: PR merge-preview integration evidence; not a raw-head checkout or complete-suite execution claim

claim_boundaries.correctness: Focused selected-signature pruning contract and existing integrated contract surface verified in hosted PR integration.
claim_boundaries.performance: none; GPU-41 does not establish latency or memory improvement despite pruning unnecessary work by construction
